thread.title: Investment Analysts’ Updated EPS Estimates for September, 10th (AAPL, ADC, AMZN, CDXC, COST, DOC, F, JWN, KALA, NKE)

author: John. R. Edwardson
title: Investment Analysts’ Updated EPS Estimates for September, 10th (AAPL, ADC, AMZN, CDXC, COST, DOC, F, JWN, KALA, NKE)
text:
Posted by John. R. Edwardson on Sep 10th, 2018 // No Comments
Investment Analysts’ updated eps estimates for Monday, September 10th:
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) had its price target boosted by Loop Capital to $256.00. Loop Capital currently has a buy rating on the stock. Get Apple Inc alerts:
Agree Realty (NYSE:ADC) had its buy rating reissued by analysts at Stifel Nicolaus. The firm currently has a $57.00 target price on the stock. Amazon.com (NASDAQ:AMZN) had its buy rating reissued by analysts at Wells Fargo & Co.
Amazon.com (NASDAQ:AMZN) had its price target raised by Citigroup Inc to $2,250.00. The firm currently has a buy rating on the stock.
Chromadex (NASDAQ:CDXC) had its buy rating reissued by analysts at HC Wainwright. The firm currently has a $8.00 price target on the stock. The analysts wrote, “Valuation methodology, risks and uncertainties. We apply a 24x EV- to-EBITDA multiple to 2020 EBITDA per share of $0.45, discounted back at 12%, which yields a price objective of approximately $8.00 per share.””
Costco Wholesale (NASDAQ:COST) had its buy rating reissued by analysts at BMO Capital Markets. BMO Capital Markets currently has a $260.00 target price on the stock.
Physicians Realty Trust (NYSE:DOC) had its buy rating reaffirmed by analysts at KeyCorp. The firm currently has a $18.00 target price on the stock.
Ford Motor (NYSE:F) had its neutral rating reaffirmed by analysts at Citigroup Inc. The firm currently has a $9.90 price target on the stock.
Nordstrom (NYSE:JWN) had its price target increased by Telsey Advisory Group from $65.00 to $72.00. They currently have an outperform rating on the stock.
Kala Pharmaceuticals (NASDAQ:KALA) had its buy rating reissued by analysts at HC Wainwright. The firm currently has a $37.00 price target on the stock. The analysts wrote, “Our 12-month target is derived from a market value of the firm at $1.1B, which includes a discounted cash flow-based asset value of $1.1B for INVELTYS (100% probability of success) and KPI-121 0.25% (65% probability of success), with a 15% discount rate and 0.5% terminal growth rate.””
Nike (NYSE:NKE) had its outperform rating reiterated by analysts at Wedbush. The firm currently has a $90.00 target price on the stock, up from their previous target price of $85.00.
Novartis (VTX:NOVN) was given a CHF 100 target price by analysts at Bank of America Corp. The firm currently has a buy rating on the stock.
Pfenex (NYSEAMERICAN:PFNX) had its outperform rating reiterated by analysts at William Blair.
Quidel (NASDAQ:QDEL) had its buy rating reiterated by analysts at Canaccord Genuity. The firm currently has a $80.00 target price on the stock.
Roche Holding Ltd. Genussscheine (VTX:ROG) was given a CHF 265 price target by analysts at Bank of America Corp. The firm currently has a neutral rating on the stock.
Reliance Steel & Aluminum (NYSE:RS) had its buy rating reissued by analysts at KeyCorp. The firm currently has a $97.00 target price on the stock.
Sanofi (EPA:SAN) was given a €95.00 ($110.47) target price by analysts at Bank of America Corp. The firm currently has a buy rating on the stock.
Semtech (NASDAQ:SMTC) had its target price increased by Piper Jaffray Companies from $57.00 to $63.00. They currently have an overweight rating on the stock.
Tactile Systems Technology (NASDAQ:TCMD) had its overweight rating reaffirmed by analysts at Piper Jaffray Companies. The firm currently has a $77.00 price target on the stock.
Wayfair (NYSE:W) had its target price boosted by Loop Capital to $155.00. The firm currently has a buy rating on the stock.
Yum! Brands (NYSE:YUM) had its buy rating reiterated by analysts at UBS Group AG. The firm currently has a $99.00 target price on the stock, up from their previous target price of $91.00.
